description: Buffer is a social media publishing and scheduling platform for managing channels, posts, ideas, and analytics across multiple networks. Its public developer offering centers on a GraphQL API, plus an MCP server and CLI for agent and automation use.
summary: Buffer exposes a GraphQL API at `https://api.buffer.com`, a remote MCP server at `https://mcp.buffer.com/mcp`, and a `buffer` CLI; the GraphQL API uses either personal API keys or OAuth 2.0 app tokens, while the MCP server supports OAuth self-onboarding and documented API-key header auth fallback.
